decision: Owner confirms the 20-byte value 0xEd50bDeeA8aDC232f159486192a4157281D722ff on chain id 4663 is a lookup signal (hook contract address) — NOT the PoolId itself. T038.md Must-not forbids deriving the PoolKey from the PoolId, so the contract is amended as follows: (a) re-label the pin in T038.md line 29 from 'PoolId' to 'second pool hook contract address 0xEd50bDeeA8aDC232f159486192a4157281D722ff (Owner-pinned, chain id 4663)' so it is no longer mislabeled as a 32-byte PoolId; (b) add a new Deliverable/Acceptance clause stating: T038 must find the Initialize event where hooks == that 20-byte address, decode the matching PoolKey, and verify keccak256(abi.encode(PoolKey)) == PoolId (which will be the actual 32-byte keccak256 digest emitted on chain); (c) PROVIDER_FACTS.md line 124 must be amended identically to re-label the pin from 'PoolId' to 'hook contract address'; (d) if no Initialize event with hooks == that address is found in the candidate window, the task reports pool_init_outside_window and excludes the second pool rather than guessing. The Developer's existing RESOLVE_PINNED_POOL_ID_SIZE_DEFECT branch must be reworked to a hook-address-scanning resolver. Implement exactly T038 as amended; do not edit T030-T037 or T036.
